data.disagreement_analysis: The 'inconclusive' verdict from qwen3-235b was caused by a tool error (LLM API request failed with HTTP 400 BadRequestError) when attempting to review .SRCINFO. This is not a security finding. deepseek-v4-flash successfully reviewed all four files including .SRCINFO and found no issues. The disagreement is purely a coverage gap due to infrastructure failure, not a substantive disagreement about the package's safety.
coverage_issues: qwen3-235b failed to review .SRCINFO due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), resulting in an inconclusive verdict
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should not produce 'inconclusive' verdicts that trigger escalation; instead, the system should retry or fall back to a simpler analysis path
When one model fails due to infrastructure error and another successfully reviews the same files, the successful review should be weighted appropriately rather than treated as a genuine disagreement
.SRCINFO is low-risk declarative metadata with no executable code; failures to parse it should not block a verdict when the PKGBUILD (from which it is generated) has been successfully audited
